topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory framing and pedagogical goals for the lecture on cancer therapy.

topics.label: Conventional cancer therapies and cytotoxic resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover traditional therapeutic modalities including surgery, radiation, and cytotoxic chemotherapy, alongside the physiological barriers and efflux mechanisms that drive drug resistance.

topics.label: Targeting intrinsic cellular vulnerabilities and DNA repair defects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore therapeutic strategies designed to exploit inherent cancer cell vulnerabilities, ranging from signaling dependence and checkpoint deficiencies to synthetic lethality.

topics.label: Targeted kinase inhibitors and mechanisms of resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics focus on targeting oncogenic driver kinases with small-molecule inhibitors and the molecular mechanisms that lead to therapeutic resistance and drug addiction.

topics.label: Antibody-based therapies and cytotoxic delivery
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how engineered monoclonal antibodies are utilized to selectively target tumor surface antigens, both directly and as targeted delivery vehicles for cytotoxic agents.

topics.label: Immune surveillance and checkpoint blockade
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate the biological evidence for natural anti-tumor immunity and the reactivation of endogenous T cells using immune checkpoint inhibitors.

topics.label: Engineered cellular and bispecific T-cell therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe synthetic immunotherapy platforms that physically redirect or genetically reprogram T cells to destroy cancer cells.

topics.label: Challenges, future directions, and clinical dilemmas in cancer management
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the broader landscape of oncology, assessing historical progress, emerging diagnostic paradigms, and the ethical dilemmas of clinical trial implementation.
